∀ {store : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.PayStore} {tariff : Minidregg.Kernel.PayTariff.Tariff} {tip : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.ChainTip} {o : Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.Observation} {credit : Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.Credit}, Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.decideObservation store tariff tip o = Except.ok credit → o.signature.length = 64 ∧ List.length o.address = 32 ∧ o.mint = tariff.mint ∧ o.tokenProgram = tariff.tokenProgram ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.bookAt store o.index = Option.some o.address ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.assignmentAt store o.index = Option.some credit.payer ∧ credit.payer ≠ tariff.asset ∧ 0 < o.amount ∧ o.slot ≤ tip.slot ∧ credit = { index := o.index, payer := credit.payer, amount := o.amount, credit := tariff.creditFor o.amount }

∀ {store : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.PayStore} {clock : Minidregg.Kernel.ClockCell.Clock} {book : Minidregg.Theory.CanonicalResourceKernel.Book} {tip : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.ChainTip} {observations : List Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.Observation} {plan : Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.Plan}, Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.decideObservations store clock book tip observations = Except.ok plan → Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.tariffOf store = Option.some plan.tariff ∧ plan.clock = clock ∧ plan.tariff.valid ∧ plan.clock.slot ≤ tip.slot ∧ ¬(observations = [] ∧ tip.slot < plan.clock.slot + plan.tariff.minTickSlots) ∧ (Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.transfers observations).Nodup ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.decideAll store plan.tariff tip observations = Except.ok plan.credits ∧ plan.tip = tip ∧ Minidregg.Theory.CanonicalResourceKernel.Batch.Admission book plan.batch

∀ {store : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.PayStore} {clock : Minidregg.Kernel.ClockCell.Clock} {book : Minidregg.Theory.CanonicalResourceKernel.Book} {tip : Minidregg.Kernel.PayCell.ChainTip} {observations : List Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.Observation} {plan : Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.Plan}, Minidregg.Kernel.PayObservation.decideObservations store clock book tip observations = Except.ok plan → ∀ o ∈ observations, plan.tariff.enrolIndex ≠ Option.some o.index
